BoundingBox.description: An axis-aligned box, normalised to the frame: top-left to bottom-right, 0..1.

CaptureFrame.description:
The single per-frame JSONL record (SPEC section 16).

The live camera, the pre-recorded fallback, tests and scenarios all feed the
pipeline through this one format. The frame itself is dropped after processing.

seq.description: Frame counter within the session, from 0.
seq.title: Seq

poses.description: One per person in frame. Two or more means somebody is assisting.
poses.title: Poses

CaptureFrame.title: CaptureFrame

CaptureSource.description: Where a capture frame came from. All three produce the same record.
CaptureSource.title: CaptureSource

ErrorType.description: The everyday-action error types in SPEC section 7.
ErrorType.title: ErrorType

EvidenceKind.description: What a piece of evidence points at. Never a video clip (SPEC section 8).
EvidenceKind.title: EvidenceKind

EvidenceRef.description:
A pointer to evidence already stored: a step event, or a span of the skeleton
replay. Never a video clip (SPEC section 8).

event_id.description: Set when kind is step_event: the StepEvent it refers to.
event_id.title: Event Id

EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

HandLandmarks.description: One hand. Steps are hand-object interactions (SPEC section 16).

landmarks.description: The 21 MediaPipe hand landmarks, in MediaPipe's own order.
landmarks.title: Landmarks

HandLandmarks.title: HandLandmarks

Handedness.description: Which hand MediaPipe thinks it is looking at.
Handedness.title: Handedness

Landmark.description: One MediaPipe landmark, normalised to the frame: x and y in 0..1, z relative.

visibility.description: Pose landmarks only; hand landmarks do not report it.
visibility.title: Visibility

LiveFrame.description:
One capture record for the skeleton view: landmarks, boxes and a timestamp,
never an image (SPEC section 8). Capped at `routine_watch.live.MAX_FRAME_FPS`.
LiveFrame.title: LiveFrame

LivePaused.description:
Monitoring is off for this resident's room (SPEC section 12), so nothing is
being watched: the socket sends this in place of what would have come next - the
session itself, or the rest of it when a nurse pauses mid-session - and closes.

room.description: The room whose monitoring is paused.
room.title: Room

LivePaused.title: LivePaused

LiveSessionEnd.description: The finished session, and the last message a session sends.

errors.description: The finished session's whole list, which is what it scored: the reading to settle on, where the error messages are every reading on the way to it.
errors.title: Errors

score.description: Weighted sum of this session's errors.
score.title: Score

flag.description: Whether this resident's own history, with this session now in it, flags a change for review (SPEC section 7).
flag.title: Flag

alert_id.description: The alert that flag shows up in, or null when nothing is flagged.
alert_id.title: Alert Id

quality.description: Whether enough of this session's capture could be read to score it (SPEC section 12). 'unclear' - a walker, a blocked view, bad lighting - is never an error: the session is neither scored nor counted towards a flag, so the screen says the capture was unclear instead of showing it as a clean session.
quality.title: Quality

LiveSessionEnd.title: LiveSessionEnd

LiveSessionStart.description:
Sent first and once: the task graph this session is following, so the dashboard
draws the map the session actually ran rather than assuming it is always tea.

task_id.description: The task graph being followed, e.g. 'make_tea'.
task_id.title: Task Id

steps.description: Every step, in the task map's reading order.
steps.title: Steps

LiveSessionStart.title: LiveSessionStart

LiveStep.description: One step of the task map, as `session_start` sends it (SPEC section 10).

id.description: The step in the task graph, e.g. 'teabag_in_cup'.
id.title: Id

label.description: How the step is shown to a nurse.
label.title: Label

deps.description: The steps this one waits on, sorted. A task is a graph of dependencies, not a fixed order (SPEC section 7), and this is what the dashboard's task map draws it from.
deps.title: Deps

optional.description: A step the task does not require, e.g. sugar.
optional.title: Optional

LiveStep.title: LiveStep

LiveStepEvent.description: One step of the task, sent once the step is over.
LiveStepEvent.title: LiveStepEvent

LiveStepStates.description:
The task map as it stands. Sent first with every step pending, and again
whenever it changes: that is the map going red and amber mid-session (SPEC
section 10). Always the current reading, so a step that turns out not to have been
missing goes back to done.

states.description: One state per step of the task, keyed by step id.
states.title: States

LiveStepStates.title: LiveStepStates

LiveTaskError.description:
One error, sent when it is first classified and once only.

Provisional: an unfinished session is classified again after every step, so this
is how it read at that moment, and `session_end` carries the list the finished
session settles on (`routine_watch.live`).
LiveTaskError.title: LiveTaskError

ObjectDetection.description:
One object box in one frame, from the local detector (SPEC section 6.1).

The detector always runs locally from downloaded weights, never hosted inference.

track_id.description: Stable across frames while the tracker holds the object.
track_id.title: Track Id

ObjectDetection.title: ObjectDetection

ObjectLabel.description:
Classes the local detector reports (SPEC section 6.1).

Making tea first, then taking medication with water (SPEC nice-to-have 4), then
the two classes every task shares. A task graph says which of these count for
which step, so a new task adds classes here and a `tasks/<name>.yaml` file and
nothing else. A class the running weights were not trained on is simply never
reported, and `routine_watch.detector.label_for` drops a class it does not know,
so the two lists may land one training run apart.
ObjectLabel.title: ObjectLabel

landmarks.description: The 33 MediaPipe pose landmarks, in MediaPipe's own order.
landmarks.title: Landmarks

StepEvent.description: A step of the task, seen happening between two times (SPEC section 6.2).

step_id.description: The step in the task graph, e.g. 'teabag_in_cup'.
step_id.title: Step Id

objects.description: Objects the step was done with.
objects.title: Objects

unclear.description: Low confidence and the verifier could not resolve it. Never an error.
unclear.title: Unclear

StepEvent.title: StepEvent

StepSource.description: What decided a step happened: the state rules, or the Gemini verifier.
StepSource.title: StepSource

TaskError.description: One everyday-action error found in a session (SPEC section 7).

step_id.description: The step the error is about. Null only when no single step applies.
step_id.title: Step Id

self_corrected.description: The resident fixed it straight away: a weaker signal, not a full error.
self_corrected.title: Self Corrected

description:
One message on the live WebSocket (`/ws/live`, SPEC section 16 decision B).

The live view crosses the pipeline/web boundary over this one socket, so its
messages are a shared shape like any other: `routine_watch.live` yields the
session's own (`session_start`, `step_state`, `frame`, `step`, `error`,
`session_end`), `routine_watch.api` sends `paused` instead when the room's
monitoring is off, and the dashboard reads them in
`web/src/live/useLiveSession.ts`.

A message is an envelope, not a record: what it carries is the contracts above,
and nothing is stored from the socket itself.
title: LiveMessage
